rules.freeze: The model implementation digest, resolved parameters, coverage behaviour, numeric tolerances and executable environment are recorded before the reserved fit runs. A freeze whose development protocol digest has moved is refused rather than reconciled.
rules.fit: One fit of the supported eight-party period over the pinned candidate rows of election_audit2022, at the parameters coverage.json resolved for that period and the registered draw seed. Nothing is retuned for the audit.
rules.outcome: The eight official two-decimal percentages of the exposed fixture, with OTHER exactly 100 minus their sum in decimal arithmetic. Errors are reported in percentage points against the drawn mean, and marginal interval inclusion at the registered 50% and 95% levels.
rules.seats: The national modified Sainte-Lague approximation of the drawn mean composition, reported beside the official constituency allocation and never merged with it.
rules.once_only: The audit runs once. A rerun at the frozen seed must reproduce the archived numbers; reproducing them is not a second audit, and no tolerance, parameter or grid moves after the run.
rules.interpretation: The reserved 2022 comparison is one retrospective pre-election diagnostic computed from today's corrected snapshot. Its polling inputs and its public outcome were already exposed to method selection, so it is neither blinded validation nor election-forecast calibration. Any fit ending 2022-08-31 is pre-election evidence on the same terms. The estimand stays voting intention on the last fieldwork date, and the prospective 2026 registration remains the forward evaluation.

fiFallback.note: Where the individual FI roster does not meet the frozen gates, its estimates stay unavailable while its source observations are retained and served. The fallback waives no other gate and changes no estimator.

manifest.rowIdentity: one-based CSV physical line; SHA-256 of UTF-8 row excluding newline
manifest.candidateSelection: 2010-01-01 <= collectPeriodFrom <= collectPeriodTo <= 2022-09-10 AND PublDate not in ['', 'NA'] AND PublDate <= 2022-09-10; compare ISO dates lexically; apply versioned eligibility rules before fitting, retaining exclusions

election.approximationNote: A national seat approximation from national shares. It omits constituency rules, including the 12% constituency exception, the split into 310 fixed and 39 adjustment seats and the return of excess fixed seats, and it is not an official allocation.
election.tieNote: An exact quotient tie is resolved by the fixed party order recorded with the rule, which makes a run reproducible. The official rule draws lots, so this is an approximation of that rule and not the legal tie procedure.
election.roundingLimitation: Official shares are the published two-decimal percentages, so each carries 0.01 percentage-point resolution and OTHER accumulates the rounding of the other eight.
election.interpretation: One retrospective pre-election diagnostic from today's corrected snapshot. Its polling inputs and its public outcome were already exposed to method selection, so it is neither blinded validation nor election-forecast calibration.

fallback.note: Where the individual FI roster does not meet the frozen gates, its estimates stay unavailable while its source observations are retained and served. The fallback waives no other gate and changes no estimator.
